fact: The Ministry of Finance invited bids in a notice with a 3 June 2024 deadline to enhance the existing online Somalia Business Registration System, including an API for stakeholder integration, payment aggregator integration and rollout to Federal Member States.
title: Request for Expression of Interest (REOI): Consultancy services to provide comprehensive technological solutions to enhance the existing online Somalia Business Registration System (SBRS)
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Federal Government of Somalia (SCALED-UP)
